content:
# Disagreement Log — 1QM Column 7

| # | Line | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Category | Resolution |
|---|------|------|-------|--------|----------|------------|
| 1 | 7:2 | "smitten with an-impurity-of his-flesh" | "afflicted with an impurity of the flesh" | "suffering from any bodily impurity" | Register | SOPHIA: "afflicted with an impurity of the flesh" per LOGOS — preserves the Hebrew idiom |
| 2 | 7:3 | "men-of-the-volunteers-for-war" | "volunteers for war" | "willing volunteer" | Redundancy | SOPHIA: "volunteers for war" — EMET is overliteral; PNEUMA's "willing" is redundant with "volunteer" |
| 3 | 7:3 | "day-of-vengeance" | "Day of Vengeance" | "Day of God's Vengeance" | Eschatological title | SOPHIA: "Day of Vengeance" capitalized — PNEUMA adds "God's" not in the Hebrew |
| 4 | 7:4 | "not pure with-respect-to his-sexual-emission" | "not ritually pure with respect to a seminal emission" | "had a seminal emission and is not yet ritually clean" | Euphemism | SOPHIA: follows LOGOS — adds "ritually" for clarity while keeping formal register |
| 5 | 7:4 | "holy-angels are-together with-their-battle-lines" | "holy angels are among their congregations" | "holy angels march in the ranks alongside the soldiers" | Key theological phrase | SOPHIA: "holy angels are among their congregations" — PNEUMA's "march in the ranks" over-militarizes; the Hebrew 'edot means congregations |
| 6 | 7:5 | "place-of-the-hand" | "latrine" | "camp latrine" | Euphemism | SOPHIA: "latrine" — EMET's literal rendering of yad is opaque; direct English is clearer |
| 7 | 7:5 | "no-unseemly nakedness" | "no indecent nakedness" | "no nakedness may be exposed" | Register | SOPHIA: "no indecent nakedness" per LOGOS — preserves the Hebrew ervat davar echo |
| 8 | 7:7 | "holy-things-of their-encampments" | "holy precincts of their encampments" | "sacred space of the encampments" | Terminology | SOPHIA: "holy precincts" per LOGOS — "holy things" is too vague; "sacred space" too modern |
| 9 | 7:9 | "for-a-bodily-need" | "for a bodily need" | "to relieve himself" | Euphemism | SOPHIA: "for a bodily need" — preserves the Hebrew euphemism; PNEUMA too colloquial |
| 10 | 7:13 | "to-frighten the enemy-of-God" | "to frighten the enemies of God" | "to terrify the enemies of God" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "to frighten the enemies of God" — "terrify" (PNEUMA) escalates beyond the Hebrew |
| 11 | 7:15 | "those-who-strip the-slain" | "those who strip the slain" | "those assigned to strip the dead" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "those who strip the slain" — "dead" (PNEUMA) loses the battle context of chalalim (slain in battle) |
| 12 | 7:17 | "men-of-understanding and men-of-strength" | "men of understanding and strength" | "intelligent, capable men" | Register | SOPHIA: "men of understanding and strength" — preserves the Hebrew dual-quality formula |
